For our architecture-level simulation, we have extended NVIDIA AIConfigurator [63]. We add DGX Spark and HyPAIC sys- tem models to AIConfigurator v0.11.0 and implement a heterogeneous-memory operation mechanism where the KV cache is stored in LPDDR5x and weights are stored in HBF.
Although HBF specifications are still evolving, this study demonstrates that integrating HBF into PAICs provides strong architectural synergy.
